businesses.business: Home fitness equipment and digital workouts

offering_description.value: The company sells exercise equipment and workout apparel to consumers. It offers instructor-led workouts through a digital membership and builds personalized training plans around members’ fitness goals.

quotes.quote: Discover Peloton’s fitness equipment and personalized workout plans. From cardio to strength, find an exercise program that keeps you motivated and on track.
Look and train your best with instructor-approved styles, performance fabrics, and exclusive collabs.

primary_products.value: Treadmills; stationary exercise bikes; workout apparel

quotes.quote: Your ride, your way. See how the Bike and Bike+ stack up and choose one that moves with you.
Look and train your best with instructor-approved styles, performance fabrics, and exclusive collabs.

primary_services.value: Instructor-led digital fitness classes; personalized workout planning

quotes.quote: No more guessing. Peloton IQ helps create your very own weekly personalized plans that adapt to your goals and keep you on track.
Whatever you’re feeling, there’s an expert instructor who lives for it. From running and cycling to strength, yoga, and more, every class is built around a community that shows up together.²
